guitar.guitaristsText: Steve Hackett / Mike Rutherford / Daryl Stuermer
guitar.evidence: Steve Hackett (early era) was known for Gibson Les Pauls; Mike Rutherford and touring guitarist Daryl Stuermer covered guitar in the Phil Collins era. No single guitar is iconic for the band's commercial 80s hits listed here.

tone.target: bright 80s pop-rock clean with chorus sheen and tight punch
tone.profile: bright 80s pop-rock clean with chorus sheen and tight punch
tone.summary: A classic 80s pop-rock chain using a Comp for punch, followed by Chorus for sheen, leading into a US Deluxe amp model paired with a bright cab, finished with EQ and Digital Delay.
